segments.name: analytical instruments
products: thermal analysis, rheometry and calorimetry instruments
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and services liquid chromatography, mass spectrometry and thermal analysis instruments, consumables and software for pharmaceutical, industrial, academic and government laboratories.
segments.evidence: Because of these similarities, the two segments have been aggregated into one reporting segment for financial statement purposes.

revenueModel.text: Pharmaceutical, industrial, academic and government customers pay for instrument systems, chromatography columns and consumables, and post-warranty service plans.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company typically has a broad and diversified customer base that includes pharmaceutical accounts, other industrial accounts, universities and governmental agencies.

changes.text: In 2026, after the BDS Business Acquisition, the Company reorganized its existing and new business units into four segments: Waters Analytical Sciences, Waters Biosciences, Waters Advanced Diagnostics and Waters Materials Sciences.
changes.evidence: Following the closing of the BDS Business Acquisition in February 2026, the Company has reorganized the existing and new business units into the following four segments: Waters Analytical Sciences, Waters Biosciences, Waters Advanced Diagnostics and Waters Materials Sciences.
